skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: 2 consecutive strikes on a single target for 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals DMG to all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes for 250% ATK, and reduces the main target's Max HP% for 2 rounds.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals DMG to all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes for 250% > 300% ATK, and reduces the main target's Max HP% > 30% for 2 rounds.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, grants 25% crit rate to self and same row for 2 rounds. Grants self and same row permanent immunity against [Burn/Forcefield/Injury/Internal Injury].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, grants 25% > 30% crit rate to self and same row for 2 > 3 rounds. Grants self and same row permanent immunity against [Burn/Forcefield/Injury/Internal Injury].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, grants 25% > 35% crit rate to self and same row for 2 > 3 rounds. Grants self and same row permanent immunity against [Burn/Forcefield/Injury/Internal Injury].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, summons 1 robot dog ([100%] ATK of Child Emperor). After an ally's action, the robot dog deals direct DMG to the enemy with the lowest HP ratio for 200% ATK as extra DMG, and heals the ally with the lowest HP ratio by 25% HP.
